title: BSNL extends broadband services contract with UTStarcom for three years
body_markdown:
# NEWSROOM


## BSNL extends broadband services contract with UTStarcom for three years


State-run Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL) Thursday extended its contract by three years with telecom infrastructure provider UTStarcom for broadband and fixed line network transformation.
